components.purpose: Jump past the bar to the content
components.keys: Tab shows it; Enter follows it
components.aria: First focusable element

components.purpose: Light, dark or mono
components.keys: Arrows move and choose; Tab leaves
components.aria: radiogroup named Color mode; checked state

components.purpose: Go to a section
components.keys: Tab, Enter
components.aria: aria-current=page on the current section

components.purpose: Open the phone menu sheet
components.keys: Enter or Space opens
components.aria: aria-expanded, aria-controls the sheet

components.purpose: The bar, folded: the wordmark at the bottom right that opens the menu
components.keys: Tab reaches it; focus shows the menu; Enter or Space pins it; Escape closes it
components.aria: aria-haspopup, aria-expanded while pinned, aria-controls the sheet

components.element: div role=group above the fold button
components.purpose: The bar's contents while it is folded: nav, mode switch, Get in touch
components.keys: Tab moves through it; Escape closes it and returns focus to the button
components.touch: Not used: touch opens the sheet
components.aria: group named Menu; its nav named Main, folded

components.purpose: The full map on phones
components.keys: Escape closes; focus trapped; focus returns to the menu button
components.touch: Tap outside or the close button
components.aria: aria-modal, labelled by its title

components.purpose: The photo tilt and its light (R-PHO-09), and the robot's glass
components.keys: None: decoration only, never needed to read or act
components.touch: Scroll light as it crosses the screen; a finger lights and follows; a sideways drag tilts; a tap blooms; tapping a robot frosts its glass and blinks it (R-INT-07)
components.aria: aria-hidden light layer; the photo keeps its alt text

components.purpose: A hover reel: a short animated design board for the row
components.keys: Focus shows it beside the row; Enter or Space opens it inline on touch or reduced motion
components.touch: Tap opens it inline with buttons; a sideways swipe scrubs it like a playhead (R-INT-07)
components.aria: role=button and aria-expanded when inline

components.element: button or a styled as one
components.purpose: One primary action per view; secondary as outline
components.keys: Enter or Space
components.aria: aria-busy while sending; disabled only when the reason is shown

components.purpose: Show what a plate measures
components.keys: Focus previews; Enter pins; Escape clears
components.touch: First tap previews and pins; tap elsewhere clears
components.aria: aria-pressed for pinned; aria-describedby its label

components.purpose: Open the contact modal
components.keys: Enter or Space
components.aria: aria-haspopup=dialog

components.purpose: Ask what someone is trying to understand
components.keys: Escape closes; focus trapped; focus returns to the trigger
components.touch: Tap outside or the close button
components.aria: aria-modal, labelled by its title, live region for status

components.element: input or textarea with a label
components.purpose: Collect one answer
components.keys: Type; Tab moves on
components.aria: aria-invalid and aria-describedby the error text

components.purpose: Reach any page
components.keys: Tab, Enter
components.aria: Grouped by section, each group a nav with a name

components.purpose: Open search
components.keys: Enter or Space; the slash key from anywhere outside a field
components.aria: aria-haspopup=dialog, aria-keyshortcuts=/

components.element: dialog with a combobox and a listbox
components.purpose: One search for pages, papers, stories and docs
components.keys: Type to search; Up and Down move; Enter opens; Escape closes; focus returns to the trigger
components.touch: Tap a result; tap outside closes
components.aria: role=combobox with aria-expanded, aria-controls the listbox, aria-activedescendant; results grouped with role=group and a name; result count in a live region

components.purpose: Narrow a list by topic, year or status
components.keys: Tab between chips; Enter or Space toggles
components.aria: aria-pressed; the group is labelled; the result count is a live region

components.element: summary of a details element, upgraded by script to a button
components.purpose: Open a paper, talk, role, campaign or person in a floating modal; without script it expands in place
components.keys: Enter or Space opens
components.aria: aria-haspopup=dialog; the modal is labelled by the record's title and sets the URL hash

components.purpose: A record's details without leaving the list
components.keys: Escape closes; focus trapped; focus returns to the row
components.touch: Tap outside or the close button
components.aria: aria-modal, labelled by its title; the hash opens it on load

components.purpose: Move through a long read
components.keys: Tab, Enter
components.touch: Tap; below 1280 it is a disclosure at the top
components.aria: nav named Contents; aria-current=location on the part in view

components.purpose: Copy a code sample or a citation
components.keys: Enter or Space
components.aria: The label changes to Copied in a live region for 2 s

components.element: form with one field and a button
components.purpose: Subscribe, join the list, request access
components.keys: Enter sends
components.aria: The field is labelled; the status line is a live region
